criteria.text: Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,600,000 (2 x ($6,300,000 - $5,000,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,200,000 is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 1 September 2026 (150 days after signing on 4 April 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 16 October 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($700,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,600,000 and the Seller's $2,200,000.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 1 September 2026, with days remaining from 23 April 2026 (131 days).
Expressly flags inconsistencies between documents (amounts, dates, periods or defined terms that differ across documents).
